verdict.rationale: Salv documents pushing customer (person) records from the client system via addPerson and CSV upload, and an endpoint that updates only the attributes provided. That implies records can be matched back to client-side identities, but the evidence never states that persons carry a stable external ID. Case records have no documented API or identifier scheme at all, and the only identifier-keyed feature (good-listing) concerns sanctions-match clearance, not record reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of client-supplied stable external IDs on persons, case API and case external identifiers, documented upsert/lookup-by-external-ID semantics, independent corroboration.
